editorial:
Imagine getting a dream job offer with a huge paycheck that seems too good to be true. That is exactly what happens to Darrin and Deb when they move near Las Vegas for a high-paying gig at CTC. Darrin is a game programmer, and his new boss wants him to build a game called Radical Rat Trap. At first, everything feels great, but the vibe quickly shifts from a corporate dream to a total nightmare. You will feel the tension build as you realize that the company is not actually interested in making fun games. Instead, they are using CD-ROM technology to hide secret messages in the software to brainwash people, including Darrin and his wife.

The movie keeps you on edge with a plot that feels like a classic 90s tech thriller. The acting is solid for a TV movie, and the way the mind control unfolds is pretty creepy. While the special effects are a bit dated, the suspense makes up for it. You should definitely check this out if you like stories about evil corporations and secret experiments. If you can find it, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best quality, or just look for it to rent on Apple TV for a quick movie night.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Darrin realizes the full scale of the mind control project. He manages to fight back against the subliminal messages and exposes the evil plans of the CTC family. In the final scenes, the brainwashing is stopped, and the villains are defeated. Darrin and Deb escape the trap, finally free from the mental manipulation, and leave the nightmare of the company behind them for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school tech conspiracies and suspenseful dramas.
